rag.text:
Test: TC-790 — Feature area - Task - Workload contouring - Editing Manual contour
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-471 Box Module - Resources - New Resource Grid
Labels: be-enterprise, can_be_automated

Steps:
1. Navigate to Resources module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-790 Feature area - Task - Workload contouring - Editing Manual contour
   Expected: Resources module is successfully loaded and displayed.
The beginning of Timeline is set to 01/Dec/2024.
Individual view - All is selected in the left top corner.
Effort mode is set to Original estimate and Units to Hours.
Scale is set to Month/Weekly.
All rows are expanded.

Following task is visible on Resources Grid:

* TC-790 Task 1
2. Look at the Workload and the Remaining capacity values for weekNumbers.
   Data: weekNumbers: 50, 51
   Expected: Workload, Remaining capacity and Capacity bars are displayed on Resource Grid.

Following values are displayed in Workload bar:

* "15" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 50
* "0" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 51

Following values are displayed in Remaining capacity bar:

* "25" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 50
* "40" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 51
3. Click on taskName.
   Data: taskName: TC-790 Task 1
   Expected: Task Details dialog is displayed.
4. Scroll down to the Workload contouring section.
   Expected: Workload contouring mode is set to manual
Workload value for the first 3 days is set to "5"
5. Change value for the first 3 days to newValue.
For the last 3 days set the value to newValue2:
Click on empty place in dialog to save changes.
   Data: newValue: 0
newValue2: 10
   Expected: Values in workload contour are set.
6. Click on the exclamation mark in Distributed effort row and confirm by clicking on 'Overwrite' button.
   Expected: Distributed workload is not equal to Original estimate. You can overwrite the Original estimate to make it equal.
7. Close Task details dialog and look at Resources Grid.
   Expected: Values on Resource grid changed.

Following values are displayed in Workload bar:

* "0" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 50
* "30" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 51

Following values are displayed in Remaining capacity bar:

* "40" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 50
* "10" in green lozenge for User "TC-790" for week 51
